headline: Chilean Supreme Court Confirms Fine and Disqualification for Former Primus Capital CEO
summary: The Supreme Court confirmed a 50,000 UF ($2,000 million) fine and a 5-year disqualification against former Primus Capital CEO Francisco Coeymans, dismissing his appeal after confirming he altered 2022 financial statements to conceal a multi-million-dollar fraud.
why: Primus Capital is a prominent non-bank financial institution in Chile, and corporate governance enforcement actions highlight regulatory oversight in the financial sector.

impacts.name: Primus Capital
impacts.why: Enforcement actions against former executives address governance risks within the financial services provider.
